raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`MiniMaxH3AdalnCache.build` reserves one slab slot per missing plan, then embeds the timesteps, writes them and queries the tensor-parallel layout. Only the checkpoint projection that follows sat inside the rollback guard, so a failure in any earlier step left the reserved slots in neither the free list nor the resident map. Each failed request shrank the cache until a later build died with `IndexError: pop from empty list`, which then failed every request.

## Modifications

- `runtime/models/dits/minimax_h3_adaln_cache.py`: move the embedding, timestep writes and tensor-parallel queries into the existing rollback guard, so every failure returns the reserved slots.
- `test/unit/test_minimax_h3_adaln_cache.py`: CPU regressions for repeated failures at each stage, with and without resident plans (eviction included). They check the free list, resident map, slot lengths and counters after every failure, and a successful retry at the end.

## Accuracy Tests

Unit: `test_minimax_h3_adaln_cache.py` 30 passed. Two host-tier tests depend on available host memory and need the override named in the commit message on small hosts; without it they fail (28 passed, 2 failed). Without the fix the new tests fail.

Real MiniMax-H3 FL2VA checkpoint, TP2 on 2 x B200, t2va, 4 s, 50 steps, seed 42. Server runs on this branch head, on a merge of the three H3 fixes (this PR, the VAE tile validation and the sigma preflight), and on unpatched `main` (`2948662026`).

**Regression** (bit-identical, so no frame comparison is shown; unpatched `main` vs this branch merged with the other two H3 fixes). Frame difference is 0 at every sampled pixel, and the video/audio latents and mp4 match bit for bit:

| | unpatched `main` | merged fixes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| video latent `[1,24,32,48,84]` + audio latent `[2,32,178]`, sha256 prefix | `e3f82e7f2006` | `e3f82e7f2006` |
| decoded mp4 (107 frames, 768x1344), sha256 prefix | `d7ffac37f960` | `d7ffac37f960` |
| max abs pixel difference, frames 0 / 53 / 106 | - | 0 / 0 / 0 |


**AdaLN cache, direct test** (real 50-layer AdaLN weights and real time-embedder weights, one rank, capacity 4; the embedding callable is made to raise). Measured on the head before the last rebase; the cache file is byte-identical on the current head.

| injected failures | free slots, `main` | free slots, this branch | outcome on `main` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 3 | 4 | injected error |
| 2 | 2 | 4 | injected error |
| 3 | 1 | 4 | injected error |
| 4 | 0 | 4 | injected error |
| 5 | 0 | 4 | `IndexError: pop from empty list` |
| 6 | 0 | 4 | `IndexError: pop from empty list` |
| then a valid build | `IndexError` | succeeds, layer 0 bit-equal to `F.linear` | |

![free slots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fusheng-ji/sglang/063f509fd4a5d9812fd7933cc2147db045ec244d/minimax-h3-slots.png)

**Fault injection on the live server** (request 1 raises inside the time embedder, request 2 is normal):

| | request 1 | request 2 | request 2 mp4 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unpatched `main` | fails (injected) | fails: `pop from empty list` | none |
| this branch (merged) | fails (injected) | completes | `d7ffac37f960`, identical to the regression run |

![request outcomes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fusheng-ji/sglang/063f509fd4a5d9812fd7933cc2147db045ec244d/minimax-h3-fault.png)

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a performance change. The fix only touches the failure path / load-time validation; the regression run below produced bit-identical output, but latency was not measured.

Limitations: the only injected fault is the embedding callable raising; everything the cache reads and computes comes from the real checkpoint. Only the FL2VA partition, t2va, TP2 and one prompt/seed were run.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not applicable: no option or documented behaviour changes.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Accuracy only; this is a correctness fix and no speed measurement was made.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_residents", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "failure_stage", ["embed_first", "embed_second", "tp_size", "tp_rank"]
+)
+def test_online_cache_failed_preparation_preserves_capacity(
+    tmp_path, monkeypatch, with_residents, failure_stage
+):
+    """Preparation failures must leave capacity reusable, even after eviction."""
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits import minimax_h3_adaln_cache
+
+    cache = _online_cache(tmp_path, max_plans=3 if with_residents else 2)
+    missing = [torch.tensor([4.0]), torch.tensor([5.0, 6.0])]
+    wanted = list(missing)
+    if with_residents:
+        residents = [torch.tensor([float(i)]) for i in range(1, 4)]
+        cache.build(residents, embed=_embed)
+        retained = residents[0]
+        retained_slot = int(cache.lookup(retained))
+        wanted.insert(0, retained)
+
+    rebuilds = cache.rebuilds
+    built_plans = cache.stats.built_plans
+    error = RuntimeError("injected preparation failure")
+
+    def fail_tp_query():
+        raise error
+
+    for _ in range(cache.max_plans + 1):
+        embed_calls = 0
+
+        def embed(timesteps):
+            nonlocal embed_calls
+            embed_calls += 1
+            if (failure_stage == "embed_first" and embed_calls == 1) or (
+                failure_stage == "embed_second" and embed_calls == 2
+            ):
+                raise error
+            return _embed(timesteps)
+
+        with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
+            if failure_stage == "tp_size":
+                patch.setattr(
+                    minimax_h3_adaln_cache, "get_tp_world_size", fail_tp_query
+                )
+            elif failure_stage == "tp_rank":
+                patch.setattr(minimax_h3_adaln_cache, "get_tp_world_size", lambda: 2)
+                patch.setattr(minimax_h3_adaln_cache, "get_tp_rank", fail_tp_query)
+            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc:
+                cache.build(wanted, embed=embed)
+            assert exc.value is error
+
+        free_slots = set(cache._free_slots)
+        resident_slots = set(cache._slots.values())
+        assert len(free_slots) == len(cache._free_slots)
+        assert free_slots.isdisjoint(resident_slots)
+        assert free_slots | resident_slots == set(range(cache.max_plans))
+        assert torch.all(cache.plan_lengths[cache._free_slots] == 0)
+        assert cache.rebuilds == rebuilds
+        assert cache.stats.built_plans == built_plans
+        for plan in missing:
+            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not cover"):
+                cache.lookup(plan)
+            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not cover"):
+                cache.resolve_slots([plan])
+        if with_residents:
+            assert int(cache.lookup(retained)) == retained_slot
+            assert cache.resolve_slots([retained]).tolist() == [retained_slot]
+            for plan in residents[1:]:
+                with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not cover"):
+                    cache.lookup(plan)
+
+    cache.build(wanted, embed=_embed)
+    resolved = cache.resolve_slots(wanted).tolist()
+    assert len(set(resolved)) == cache.max_plans
+    assert not cache._free_slots
+    for plan, slot in zip(wanted, resolved):
+        assert int(cache.lookup(plan)) == slot
+    assert cache.rebuilds == rebuilds + 1
+    assert cache.stats.built_plans == built_plans + len(missing)
+
+
